status: Qualified opt-in pinned expert upload staging; full goal active and incomplete

behavior.admission: Positive pinned budget must cover one complete expert and requires all three backend hooks. Total staging budget still covers the SAME allocation; zero keeps ordinary staging. No live upgrade.
behavior.ownership: One backend-owned pinned host bundle and nonblocking upload stream per serialized model expert store; no pinning of the RAM cache. Store owns lifecycle; sessions retain ordinary compute state.
behavior.batch: Validate all projection descriptors before allocation/copy. Allocate missing handles privately, enqueue three H2D copies, synchronize the upload stream once, then expose successful handles and publish the cache entry.
behavior.failure: Drain attempted copies before return. Batch failure leaves item handles unchanged, destroys newly allocated handles, and treats existing buffers as potentially poisoned. Store abort clears the entire failed reservation without publication. Host source lease survives through completion.
behavior.compatibility: Existing model/store entry points pass pinned_budget=0. No kernel, arithmetic, routing, grouping, head geometry, or legacy default-path change.
behavior.timing: Main forward elapsed time includes RAM-to-pinned copies and completed CPU-logit publication. upload_time_ms begins at the backend batch callback and excludes the preceding host memcpy; do not compare this counter alone with pageable driver staging.
